fields.title: Replace Python-era Rust API names with behavior-based names

data.text: Inventory: PyInt and six py_* helper names span 24 Rust files. Preserve format-1 boolean/integer fields, numeric parsing, Unicode whitespace, and byte-preserving URL normalization; rename APIs by behavior and document the contracts. Baseline running before edits.

Expanded scope per user: rewrite port-history comments throughout Rust source and tests. Stacked branch roll-dih8.17-rust-names on PR #2 head 08292dd. Pristine PR2 baseline: 782 passed, 1 pre-existing failure in hardening::v1::v1_push_side_translation::git_keeps_the_rejection_tokens_bead_reads_untranslated; git returned failed to update ref instead of the expected token. Original branch baseline and initial rename baseline both passed 772 tests.

Cleanup complete on roll-dih8.17-rust-names, based directly on PR #2 head 08292dd. Renamed PyInt to IntegerField, py_* text helpers to operation names, and pathlib helpers to normalize_path/join_path; rewrote port-history comments throughout Rust source while retaining fixture and generator provenance. Final fmt and strict workspace Clippy pass. ./check.sh: 782 passed, 1 failed, 3 skipped; 14 infra tests pass. The sole failure is the V1 Git rejection-token test, reproduced on pristine PR #2 before applying changes: git 2.43.0 emits failed to update ref instead of incorrect old value provided. This is the existing roll-k2wy.17 issue. Preparing a draft PR stacked on #2; no runtime or format changes.

Draft PR #3 is published: https://github.com/bpcakes/beadroll/pull/3 . Its base is roll-lqjj-follow-ups (PR #2), with one cleanup commit f9e223a. Working tree is clean. Validation and the inherited roll-k2wy.17 Git-message failure are documented in the PR. Leaving this issue open until the stack is merged to main.

Second pass requested: include remaining Python/CPython references and every AGENTS.md. Rename historical test/helper identifiers, rewrite assertion messages and guide prose, move fixture/generator provenance into the historical port document, and retain actual interpreter invocations and environment settings. Pre-edit baseline remains 782 passed and the known V1 Git-message failure.

Second pass pushed as 7880800 to PR #3, still based on PR #2. Rewrote all eight AGENTS.md guides; renamed remaining historical test/helper names and the seeded random module; updated active finding references; moved CPython fixture/generator provenance into RUST-PORT.md section 4.2. Remaining Python matches describe active interpreter tooling, environment settings, or generator paths. fmt and strict Clippy pass; baseline: 782 passed, known inherited V1 failure, 3 skipped, 14 infra passed. Both final test-name corrections pass focused checks. Verified generator header, unchanged Unicode table and unchanged algorithms/fixture values.

Manifest follow-up: changed beadroll-core description from Python-compatible JSON to strict JSON; described test support directly; removed remaining references to former modules and port history from Cargo comments. cargo metadata --no-deps --locked validates all package descriptions, and parsed TOML comparison confirms all non-description values are unchanged. Running required baseline before pushing to the existing stacked PR.

Manifest cleanup pushed as 29e1fa9 to PR #3, stacked on #2. cargo metadata validates; baseline again has 782 passed, the existing V1 Git-message failure, 3 skipped, and all 14 infra tests passing. No Python or CPython wording remains in Cargo manifests.

PR #2 is merged at main 274d4ff. Integrating main into the PR #3 branch without rewriting its commits, preserving the two review follow-ups (retry-bound regression tests and corrected guide invariants). Merge is conflict-free; baseline and strict Clippy are running before push and retargeting PR #3 to main.

PR #3 now targets main after PR #2 merged. Pushed merge commit 8918f91, preserving main follow-ups without rewriting branch history. fmt and strict Clippy pass. Baseline: 784 passed, inherited V1 Git-message failure, 3 skipped; all 14 infra tests pass. PR description and validation counts updated. Cleanup remains open pending PR #3 merge.

Addressed the five comprehensive-review documentation findings: rewrote remaining item/test port-history comments, restored parity fixture provenance, pinned generator instructions, and corrected timestamp/descriptor docs. Rust executable lines unchanged except one test name; generator AST unchanged. Controller validation follows.
